At HEAD only two values used 'с хаба' (one verb-governed, 'сняли с хаба'); this delta adds the other two. 'С хаба' is idiomatic and 6.91 px narrower; the probe measured the 'Из хаба' quartet at 237.15 px natural sum (fits the 246 px row with 8.85 px slack, no well scroll, but 5.15 px over the remediation's 232 px target). Not gating: adopt 'Из хаба' only if cross-surface consistency outranks the extra margin (and re-capture the frame), else keep 'С хаба' and record the width call.

Grammatical, impersonal and true in the only state that renders it (a query routes to empty.search first); it diverges in shape from its nominal siblings 'Своих агентов нет.' / 'Встроенных агентов нет.'. Parallel alternative is style only.
